persistencePair.selectedAllocationFailure: Parent or view failures can leave metadata, protection or a parent reservation; the view-pin failure has no parent rollback. Exhaustion assertion can terminate in debug. Sync failure requires a guest page smaller than the host page. No successful pointer or no-effect failure is fabricated.
persistencePair.selectedFreeFailure: MmFreePhysicalMemory ignores type, asserts 32-byte alignment, selects heap by address and ignores Release bool. Zero selects virtual heap 0 and is rejected. A valid A-base releases parent first, then watched invalidation when its condition holds, then local view; false can follow partial effects. Region-start checks are page-based, weaker than byte-base equality.
